findings.consequence: The whitespace can read as a layout gap instead of a chosen interval in the club programme.

findings.observation: The official storyboard adds a real production artifact and makes the reading thesis more specific; its caption is intentionally quiet and remains legible at the tested sizes.
findings.consequence: This is a resolved improvement over the earlier copy-only reading band, but it should remain tied to the source credit if the material changes.
